info.title: TERRA API
info.description:
Backend TERRA — platform dua sisi untuk menyalurkan hasil panen yang tidak
terserap pasar. Dibangun untuk **GEMASTIK 2026**.

API-only. Klien produksinya adalah aplikasi React Native yang dikerjakan
terpisah; halaman ini (`/docs`) adalah kontrak API sekaligus antarmuka
pengujian manual.

### Alur utama

**Maju (petani):** `POST /klasifikasi` → `POST /penawaran` →
`GET /penawaran/{id}/rekomendasi` → `GET /penawaran/{id}/pembeli` →
`GET /penawaran/{id}/kartu`

**Balik (pembeli):** `POST /permintaan` → *petani memublikasikan penawaran
yang cocok* → `GET /notifikasi/saya` → `GET /kecocokan/saya`

### Cara memakai halaman ini

Tekan **Authorize** di kanan atas dan isi salah satu token demo:
`demo-petani-1`, `demo-petani-2`, `demo-pembeli-1` … `demo-pembeli-6`.

### Yang masih placeholder

| Bagian | Status |
|---|---|
| Klasifikasi YOLO | **Tiruan.** Bentuk respons final; hasil dibuat-buat tapi bervariasi dan konsisten per foto. Cek `sumber_placeholder`. |
| Pengiriman push | **Dicatat, tidak dikirim.** Notifikasi tersimpan dan dapat dibaca lewat `GET /notifikasi/saya`. |
| Penyimpanan foto | **Tiruan.** URL foto tidak menunjuk ke berkas nyata. |

Selain tiga hal di atas, seluruh logika bersifat nyata.

### Yang sengaja tidak dibangun

Perhitungan biaya angkut, penyaringan berdasarkan nilai bersih setelah ongkir,
konsolidasi pengiriman antar petani, dan pemrosesan pembayaran — semuanya di
luar lingkup (PRD §3.2). Jarak dipakai untuk menyaring dan mengurutkan saja.

post.summary: Klasifikasi otomatis dari foto (B-01 … B-06, B-08)
post.description:
Upload photos and get back a condition label.

⚠️ **Hasil saat ini berasal dari pengklasifikasi tiruan**, bukan model YOLO
terlatih — lihat `sumber_placeholder` pada respons. Bentuk respons sudah
final dan tidak berubah saat model asli dipasang.

Hasil bervariasi antar foto tapi konsisten untuk foto yang sama, sehingga
demo dapat diulang. Sekitar 1 dari 8 foto sengaja menghasilkan keyakinan
rendah agar jalur konfirmasi manual (B-06) dapat diperagakan.

Declare the condition yourself, without a model in the loop.

The result is tagged `manual_dilaporkan_sendiri` and stays visually
distinguishable to buyers wherever it appears (PRD F-03).

Publish harvest so buyers can find it.

Creating an offer immediately runs it against every active buyer demand
(PRD E-02) and notifies whoever matches (E-03). `jumlah_permintaan_cocok`
in the response tells you how many buyers were alerted.

Post standing demand -- the reverse flow (PRD §10.2).

Farmers publishing matching supply after this will trigger a notification
to you, without you searching.

get.summary: 2-3 opsi penyaluran untuk sebuah penawaran (C-01 … C-05)
get.description:
Disposal/sale options for a published offer.

Every option carries `id_aturan` -- the row in `config/rule_base.yaml`
that produced it (PRD C-01 acceptance, NF-06). Options are also marked
with whether a matching buyer actually exists nearby (C-03).

The whole rule table as currently loaded.

Exposed so the team can confirm an edit to `config/rule_base.yaml`
actually took effect, without database access or a redeploy.

⚠️ Isi tabel ini masih berasal dari studi literatur dan belum divalidasi
lewat wawancara pembeli (PRD §15).

get.summary: Pembeli terdekat yang cocok, terurut (D-01 … D-06)
get.description:
Forward flow: the farmer sees who can take this harvest.

Ranked by condition relevance, then proximity (PRD D-03). Every row
carries `alasan` -- the component scores and weights behind its position
(NF-06). An empty result explains which filter removed each candidate
rather than returning a bare empty list.

Distance filters and ranks. It is never converted into a cost -- transport
economics are out of scope (PRD §3.2).

Reverse flow: what has matched the demands this buyer posted.

These rows are created automatically when a farmer publishes matching

post.description:
Record an agreed deal.

Terra records that an agreement happened; it does not process payment or
hold funds (out of scope, PRD §3.2). This record is what both reputation
directions and the impact dashboard are computed from.

post.summary: Selesaikan transaksi dan beri penilaian (§10.1 langkah 8)

post.description:
Cancel after agreement -- recorded against whoever cancelled.

This is the buyer-side accountability half of PRD F-06: the interview
finding was that farmers absorb 100% of the loss when a verbally-agreed
order is pulled, with no reputational consequence for the buyer.

schema.title: Response Transaksi Saya Transaksi Saya Get

post.description: File a post-transaction mismatch report with comparison photos.

Confirm or reject a report; only confirmed ones move a score.

⚠️ **Belum ada peran moderator.** Endpoint ini terbuka untuk semua
pengguna terautentikasi, yang jelas tidak memadai di luar MVP. Autentikasi
tingkat produksi berada di luar lingkup saat ini (context.md) -- siapa pun
yang menambahkan peran pengguna sebaiknya menutup endpoint ini lebih dulu.

get.summary: Reputasi dua arah seorang pengguna (F-05, F-06, F-07)
get.description:
Reputation derived from logged events, not from free-text reviews.

`ringkasan_teks` states what the numbers are made of, so the counterparty
sees the basis and not just a figure (PRD F-06 acceptance).

get.summary: Notifikasi saya, yang mendesak lebih dulu (H-01, H-02)
get.description:
Notifications for the signed-in user.

⚠️ **Pengiriman push masih placeholder.** Notifikasi disusun, diberi
prioritas dan disimpan sungguhan, tapi tidak dikirim ke perangkat -- lihat
`status_kirim` dan `modules/notifications/pengirim.py`. Endpoint ini
adalah cara memverifikasi bahwa pencocokan balik (E-03) benar-benar
memicu notifikasi ke pembeli yang tepat.

schema.title: Response Notifikasi Saya Notifikasi Saya Get

get.description:
Card content for the native share sheet.

Returns data, not a rendered page: the React Native app draws the card and
hands it to the OS share sheet (G-02). There is no web surface in this
product, so the §6.7 acceptance criterion about a WhatsApp *link preview*
is not met -- that would require a public HTML page with OG tags.

`lokasi_umum` is deliberately coarse. Cards land in open groups, and the
farmer's exact pin should not travel with them.

post.description:
Called by the app after the share sheet closes.

Feeds the `card_shared` metric -- how much the external-channel path is
actually used, which is one of the proposal's core behavioural claims.

get.description:
Active listings and discussion for an area.

A passive information surface. No shipment pooling is built on top of it,
by design (PRD G-04, §3.2).

Cumulative value recovered, volume diverted, successful connections.

Aggregated from the signed-in user's own transaction history (I-02) --
no platform-wide figures, and nothing extrapolated.

BuatPenawaranRequest.title: BuatPenawaranRequest
BuatPenawaranRequest.description:
Publish harvest for matching.

Two ways in, matching PRD §10.1:

* **From a classification** -- pass `id_klasifikasi` and the commodity and
  condition fields are taken from that run.
* **Self-reported** -- omit `id_klasifikasi` and supply `komoditas`,
  `pemicu`, `jenis_kondisi` and `tingkat_keparahan` yourself. The offer is
  tagged `manual_dilaporkan_sendiri` (PRD B-07, F-03).

keparahan_maksimal.description: Batas atas keparahan yang masih diterima.

rentang_harga.description: Harga yang ditawarkan pembeli per kg PRODUK. Bukan ongkos angkut.

koordinat.description: Kosongkan untuk memakai lokasi terdaftar pembeli.

BuatTransaksiRequest.title: BuatTransaksiRequest
BuatTransaksiRequest.description:
Record that a deal was agreed.

Terra does not process payment or hold escrow (PRD §3.2) -- this is a
record that two parties agreed, which is what both reputation directions
and the impact dashboard are computed from.

Citra.title: Citra
Citra.description:
One photo attached to an offer (PRD §8 `citra`, B-02).

`waktu_ambil` and the capture coordinates come from the device at capture
time. PRD F-01 requires in-app capture rather than gallery upload; the
backend enforces the *presence* of this metadata, which is as far as
server-side verification can go.

alamat_umum.title: Alamat Umum
alamat_umum.description: Lokasi umum yang ditampilkan ke pihak lain, bukan titik persis.

DaftarPetaniRequest.title: DaftarPetaniRequest
DaftarPetaniRequest.description: PRD A-01 + A-02. Deliberately few fields (NF-02: max 3 steps).

nilai_terpulihkan.title: Nilai Terpulihkan
nilai_terpulihkan.description: Total nilai produk yang berhasil disalurkan, Rupiah. Nilai kotor produk -- tanpa potongan ongkos angkut, yang memang tidak dimodelkan (PRD §3.2).

DampakResponse.title: DampakResponse
DampakResponse.description: PRD I-01: cumulative impact for one user.

Deteksi.title: Deteksi
Deteksi.description:
One detected region, shaped like a YOLO detection.

`kotak` is [x_center, y_center, width, height], normalised 0-1 -- the
Ultralytics `xywhn` convention, so the real model's output maps straight
across with no rescaling.

KartuBerbagi.title: KartuBerbagi
KartuBerbagi.description:
PRD G-01: the shareable offer card, as data.

The React Native app renders this natively and passes the result to the
OS share sheet (G-02). The backend deliberately does not render HTML or
an image -- there is no web surface in this product (context.md).

KecocokanTercatat.title: KecocokanTercatat
KecocokanTercatat.description: A stored match, as shown to a buyer in the reverse flow.

KetersediaanPembeli.title: KetersediaanPembeli
KetersediaanPembeli.description:
PRD C-03: does a buyer for this recommendation actually exist nearby?

Deliberately thin -- a count and the nearest distance, nothing about who.
A recommendation only needs to say "yes, N buyers within X km can take
this" or "no match found, informational only". The buyer list itself is
the matching endpoint's job.

citra.title: Citra
citra.description: Opsional. Foto yang sudah diunggah sebelumnya, jika ada.

KlasifikasiManualRequest.title: KlasifikasiManualRequest
KlasifikasiManualRequest.description:
PRD B-07: the manual path a farmer can always fall back to.

The resulting listing is tagged `manual_dilaporkan_sendiri` and stays
visibly distinguishable from CV-classified listings wherever a buyer sees
it (PRD F-03).

VerifikasiCitra.title: VerifikasiCitra
VerifikasiCitra.description:
Trust signals attached to a classification (PRD F-01, F-02).

Server-side verification can only go so far: the backend cannot prove a
photo came from the in-app camera rather than the gallery. What it can do
is check that the capture metadata PRD B-02 requires is actually present,
and compare the geotag against the farmer's registered location. Both
outcomes are reported, never silently swallowed.
